# RewardBox

> One Python interface (`import rewardbox`, CLI `rewardbox`) for 35 configurations of 14 robot reward-model methods (Robometer, RoboReward, TOPReward, Robo-Dopamine, GVL, VLAC, VLAC-Cut, PRIMO-R1, Flora-Rewarder, SOLE-R1, LRM, RynnValue, ProcVLM, Robo-ValueRL). Adapters call each method's official code at a pinned commit, keep raw output scales and the upstream sampling protocol, and share one Trajectory -> RewardOutput contract. Four extra protocol profiles (`vlm-sequence`, `vlm-pair`, `jev-1.14-sequence`, `jev-1.14-pair`) query general VLMs and Jev through HTTP APIs. Released with the paper as RRM-Hub, alongside the RRM-Bench-1K benchmark.

Ask the live registry first: `rewardbox list --json`, `rewardbox info NAME --json`, `rewardbox doctor NAME`, `rewardbox fetch-upstream --list --json`.
